description: Source code implementing the im2col operation optimized for Apple Metal Performance Shaders (MPS), including functions for preparing and executing GPU kernels for tensor transformations in PyTorch's native MPS backend.

methods.name: im2col_out_mps_template
methods.description: Performs the im2col operation on input tensor with specified kernel size, dilation, padding, and stride, and writes the result to output tensor using Metal shaders.

methods.name: im2col_out_mps
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls im2col_out_mps_template to produce the im2col output tensor.

methods.name: im2col_mps
methods.description: Creates and returns a tensor containing the im2col transformation of the input tensor.
